_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Coil with flat momentum, calm funding, and no 12h breaker; base rate favors HOLD until score moves ±2+.
next_move.brains_agree: Partial — analyst explicitly HOLD→Complacency; narrative silent on forward call (only confirms current Anxiety)
next_move.confirmed_if: BTC range-bound, fear/greed ~45-55, 30d momentum flat, funding/vol unshocked
next_move.invalidated_if: Range break moving score ±2+: downside if ETF flows stay dead while longs unwind and fear/greed <40; upside if ETF flows rebound and 30d momentum turns decisively positive
